model_policy.long_rule: Choose long only when domestic_producer_channel selects positive AND that option has raw probability >= 0.70; all other valid outputs mean cash.
model_policy.failures: unknown; preserve every source and arm; no automatic uncertain retries
model_policy.source_selection: Fixed 10,000-byte keyword-neighborhood current-source evidence for both models; no returns, manually transcribed tables or later issuer exposures supplied.

calendar_policy: Use SPY daily dates as the observed session calendar. Validate currency and exchange timezone. Entry is the first session close strictly after Federal Register publication date; exit is five sessions after entry. Never move entry because an issuer price is missing.
cost_interpretation: Unverified illustrative round-trip equity basket costs, not measured executable spreads or data, broker, hedge or borrow costs. Cash has zero cost.
return_definition: Equal-weight mean of NUE and STLD adjusted-close returns. Subtract SPY return for a descriptive market-relative comparison; no hedge position or hedge cost is implied.
primary_reporting: Mean contribution across all 20 documents, including valid cash observations as zero. Any required model or price failure makes the primary aggregate inconclusive; means conditional on computable rows are secondary.
dependence: Report per-document results and transitive clusters of overlapping windows. Cluster means of document contributions are descriptive, not simulated capital allocations or independent causal episodes. No annualized Sharpe, p-values or compounded portfolio.
directions: Long-only primary rule. No short signal, order or borrow claim.
data_provider: Yahoo Finance public daily chart responses if accessible. Archive response bytes and URLs. Adjustment documentation: https://help.yahoo.com/kb/SLN28256.html
limitations: Historical development association proxy, not an as-of strategy backtest or held-out alpha.
Current archived source versions and contemporary models can contain hindsight.
Historical issuer exposure and first-public availability are not fully verified.
Federal Register publication often follows earlier announcements; this tests only the delayed publication window.
One horizon and fixed threshold, with no modifications after prices. The tiny dependent cohort does not establish general profitability.
Adjusted closes are not executable quotes; spreads and realistic trading costs remain unverified.
interpretation_rule: Positive Jev results above both controls only earn an independent prospective or larger locked study. Nonpositive primary market-relative Jev contribution after illustrative costs means no financial evidence for this frozen rule. Preserve the result and stop tuning CORE on this sample.
